notes.title: Devblog
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596358/e96b707ac7a0706f9fce6bd08cf7b5e0c52f9ef1.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello.[/p][p]All the renders are ready, and now I'm working on translating the demo version of the game.[/p][p]I received feedback from you that the translation needs improvement, and I will try to make it better.[/p][p]The demo version has been expanded. In addition to expanded dialogues, I have added an intimate scene with a new character who will be important to the plot. The relationship with this character will depend on the player's decisions.[/p]

notes.title: Development Status
notes.content:
Hi.
Continuing to create an update to the demo and getting ready to release an early version of CLR on Steam in June.
We know that most of you value manual labor more than neural network work right now, so 90% of the game will be replaced with images created by the author. This decision has led to the fact that CLR will no longer use sprites. This way we can make the game more interesting and cinematic.
Thank you for your support and interest in the game. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596358/4474c5e8b1de397bb30f7e62c39ab238174f4153.png[/img]
